title: A Product I Never Expected to Discuss Again
content: A new market trend has emerged this year.  Financial products that had seemingly been left for dead have returned to life.  Binary options, which were launched in 2008, never really took off in their exchange-traded formats but later morphed into the basic logic behind prediction markets (such as IBKR ForecastTrader).  Today, the CME returns single stock futures (SSF) to the market landscape.  Hey, at least this means we can once again refer to quarterly expirations as “quadruple witching.”

title: Brian Armstrong：AI Agent将使加密货币对全球支付更重要
content:
Odaily星球日报讯 Coinbase 联合创始人兼 CEO Brian Armstrong 表示，AI 与加密货币是互补技术，AI 趋势不会削弱加密货币，反而使其更重要。他认为，AI Agent 未来需要在无需每一步等待人工批准的情况下赚取、持有和支出资金。
Brian Armstrong 预计，AI Agent 未来每日完成的交易数量将超过所有人类总和，并需要实时可编程货币。Coinbase 正将 USDC、Base 区块链和 x402 支付协议定位为该市场核心基础设施。
Coinbase 将其相关战略称为 Agentic Finance，正在开发允许 AI 系统在用户设定限制内访问钱包、付款和执行金融指令的工具。公司近期已通过 Coinbase Business 推出面向企业的 USDC AI Agent 支付功能。
